headline: AI Research Arms Race Intensifies as Competitors Launch Verified-Data Assistants
bottomLine: OpenAI and IEEE are launching enterprise AI research tools with verified-source positioning, directly challenging LeapSpace's market entry window while Danish institutions face urgent pressure to adopt next-gen discovery platforms.
keyFindings: OpenAI's new Data Agent and IEEE's AI Research Suite both emphasize expert-vetted, verified research sources—directly mirroring LeapSpace's core value proposition and fragmenting the…
